issues.description: Uses from_pretrained(dtype=...) even though the declared transformers>=4.42 floor expects torch_dtype, risking load failure or ignored dtype.
generate-stories requires an existing stories manifest, so a fresh checkout cannot generate the missing dataset described by the README.
Default config points to data/stories, but the repository contains no story files, so make demo/extract cannot run from a clean checkout.
Story loading does not validate the dataset manifest or report missing per-topic files cleanly before read_text failures.
HTTP story generation has no timeout/retry handling and will send bearer tokens to any configured API base, including plaintext HTTP.
choice_logits forces batch size to at least 8, ignoring smaller user-configured batch sizes and increasing OOM risk.
pca_components divides by total variance without handling zero-variance input, producing NaNs on degenerate neutral activations.
Integration test only checks that steering changes Elo, not that the claimed correlation-vs-shift validation criterion actually holds.
Checked-in tiny steering result contradicts the README claim: correlation_vs_shift_r is negative and a negative-correlated emotion raises steered Elo.
README overstates the steering validation conclusion despite the checked-in output not showing shift tracking correlation.
Generated egg-info metadata is tracked in source control and can become stale relative to pyproject metadata.
Generated experiment artifacts are checked into the repo, including large npy/npz outputs that obscure source changes and may go stale.
